California Supreme Court Orders Return of Seized Ballots

The California Supreme Court has ordered a Republican sheriff in Riverside County to return approximately 650,000 ballots that were seized. The court ruled that the seizure was unlawful. The sheriff's department had seized the ballots, and the court's decision mandates their return.
